name: edit_project
description:
Update project-level settings or speakers.

Actions:
- update: change project name/description.
- speaker-create / speaker-update / speaker-delete: manage the speaker list used by transcripts.

Canvas size, aspect ratio, and fps are per-timeline state — change them with manage_timelines action=update.

After your first edit on a project marked "(auto-named)" in the snapshot, use this to rename it.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.
